title: 通用三重潜在压缩与门控关联检索
summary: 研究通用三重潜在序列模型，通过维护运行令牌状态和压缩对记忆路径来捕获高阶令牌交互，无需基准特定解析。该系列改进了小型Transformer在字节级WikiText-2和基于分词器的MiniMind语言模型基准上的性能，而专注于召回的门控键值检索扩展提高了关联召回，但对种子敏感且当前参考实现速度较慢。
summary_en: Studies generic triple-latent sequence models that maintain a running token state and compressed pair-memory pathway to capture higher-order token interactions without benchmark-specific parsing. The family improves a small Transformer baseline on byte-level WikiText-2 and a tokenizer-based MiniMind benchmark, while a recall-focused gated key-value retrieval extension improves associative recall but remains seed-sensitive and slower in the current implementation.
